Planning date: 2026-11-05

Status: infeasible



Durations and buffers are user estimates. Dates require official confirmation where marked unknown.



## 1. Start your HKU SAO registration



You can start the registration when you plan to apply for a summer programme.

Suggested start: 2026-11-05

Latest start (calculated): 2027-05-22

Official deadline: To confirm

Prerequisites: None stated

Documents: To confirm





> You can open the application as soon as you plan to apply for a summer programme.

Source: https://intlaffairs.hku.hk/backend/faqs/sao-application/



## 2. Apply to the host institution



Submit your programme application directly to the host institution.

Suggested start: 2026-11-05

Latest start (calculated): 2027-04-22

Official deadline: To confirm

Prerequisites: None stated

Documents: To confirm





> Apply with the host institution directly.

Source: https://intlaffairs.hku.hk/backend/faqs/sao-application/



## 3. Receive the host institution's offer



Wait for and obtain your admission letter.

Suggested start: 2026-11-12

Latest start (calculated): 2027-05-02

Official deadline: To confirm

Prerequisites: host_application

Documents: To confirm





> After receiving your admission

Source: https://intlaffairs.hku.hk/backend/faqs/sao-application/



## 4. Submit the HKU SAO registration



After receiving admission, submit your HKU registration as instructed.

Suggested start: To confirm

Latest start (calculated): 2027-05-12

Official deadline: To confirm

Prerequisites: offer_received

Documents: To confirm





> Submit your registration with IAO.

Source: https://intlaffairs.hku.hk/backend/faqs/sao-application/

## 5. Check HKU SAO funding eligibility

Suggested start: 2026-11-26

Latest start (calculated): 2027-05-22

> No separate application is necessary.

Source: https://intlaffairs.hku.hk/backend/faqs/sao-funding/
